subject.title: [Feature]: No way to view/manage paired contacts & permissions

question: Should OpenClaw add a terminal admin contact inventory for WhatsApp pairing and allowlists, and what fields, redaction, account scope, and authorization should it expose?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the requested surface exposes sensitive sender identifiers, authorization state, and activity data while overlapping existing `/allowlist`, directory, status, and narrower pairing-management work.

options.title: Define scoped admin inventory
options.body: Add a designed CLI/admin surface that merges pairing-store approvals, config allowlists, directory labels, and an explicitly chosen activity source under account-scope and redaction rules.

options.title: Narrow to pairing management first
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/56621 for approved-list and revoke commands, then defer group-policy and last-active columns until privacy and storage semantics are decided.

options.title: Defer core surface
options.body: Keep management in existing config and `/allowlist` flows until maintainers choose a broader admin model or plugin/API boundary.

recommendation.title: Define scoped admin inventory
recommendation.body: Add a designed CLI/admin surface that merges pairing-store approvals, config allowlists, directory labels, and an explicitly chosen activity source under account-scope and redaction rules.

likelyOwner.reason: The overlapping `/allowlist` surface and product/security boundary make steipete the best available owner from the likely-owner history.
